best_ability.why: Confirmed by the wiki's own damage formula — ((Base + Upgrade + SP×1.5) × stack multiplier) — Sticky Bomb is the only ability in the game whose damage grows permanently all match while scaling at ×1.5. nuke.damage_math: Sticky Bomb, maxed: (110 base + 85 Tier-2 upgrade = 195) + ×1.5 scaling × 154 SP (final loadout Spirit Power from items: 134 flat + 15% (Boundless Spirit) ≈ 154 effective) = ~426 per bomb at zero stacks. The permanent stack multiplier is the real story: at a modest +15% mid-game stack that is ~490 per bomb, Echo Shard plants two of them (~980 burst on one area), and Mystic Reverb's echo plus Escalating Exposure's amp push real fights past that. Damage uses Spirit Power at cast time — cast fat, not early.
nuke.kit_synergy: Every imbue goes on Sticky Bomb. Rapid Recharge and cooldown compression keep a bomb on someone at all times, Echo Shard double-plants, and Mystic Reverb echoes the detonation — while the permanent stack multiplier compounds quietly until bombs are deleting carries outright.

situational.when: Enemy stacking spirit resist — your damage falls off
situational.note: Every spirit hit strips 8% of their spirit resist and stacks +4.5% spirit amp, up to 12 stacks — resist stacking becomes a countdown timer. Already in this build — buy it a phase earlier instead of waiting for the full build.

situational.when: Long-range poke you can't reach
situational.note: 11m blink straight through their sightline on a 16s cooldown — you arrive inside their range instead of dying outside it.

cn.cn_note: CN Bebop is the hook-bomb loop at full tempo: Mystic Burst and Spirit Strike open every trade, Trophy Collector snowballs the early kills Chinese lobbies force around the first Guardian, Spirit Snatch steals the resist the enemy bought to survive the bomb, Tankbuster turns the bomb into a tank answer.
